studio.createHint: Start with a topic or your script, save revisions, then generate.
studio.sceneHint: Scenes set narration order and planning duration. Rendering uses the selected material clip duration.
studio.libraryHint: Import owned or licensed media. Verified files keep their content identity.
studio.lineageHint: For copies, edits or transcodes, select the original. Reimporting matching content preserves permanent publishing history.
studio.accountsHint: Connect accounts and verify their platform identity before publishing.
studio.publishHint: Choose content and accounts, run preflight, confirm, then send each target.

studio.evidence_NO_DEFINITIVE_RECEIPT: Read-only lookup found no definitive publication proof
studio.diagnosticHint: Inspect local configuration and executable interfaces. This check does not generate, publish or call a paid provider.
studio.diagnostic_NOT_CONFIGURED: Generator is not configured. Provision the pinned environment and bind its generator.json to the service.
studio.diagnostic_NOT_INSTALLED: Generator environment is missing or invalid. Run the installation verification and check the component wheel.
studio.diagnostic_INVALID: Configuration validation failed. Resolve the checks below.
studio.diagnostic_CALLABLE: Local configuration and CLI checks passed. The generation entry is callable; real output and online paths remain unverified.
studio.diagnostic_code_GENERATOR_NOT_CONFIGURED: Bind the installation output with --generator-config and --media-config, then restart the service.
studio.diagnostic_code_CONFIG_INVALID: Use the documented JSON configuration schema.
studio.diagnostic_code_COMPONENT_MANIFEST_INVAL: Use the pinned revision and a real artifact digest from the installer.
studio.diagnostic_code_COMPONENT_WHEEL_INVALID: Install the original recorded wheel and verify its digest and layout.
studio.diagnostic_code_PROVIDER_CONFIG_INVALID: Check that the private TOML reference exists, parses, uses declared fields and has mode 0600.
studio.diagnostic_code_COMPONENT_ENVIRONMENT_IN: Use the independent installed interpreter and matching wheel; verify dependencies.
studio.diagnostic_code_COMPONENT_CLI_UNSUPPORTE: Reinstall the pinned CLI and its locked dependencies.
studio.diagnostic_code_MEDIA_TOOLS_INVALID: Provide executable ffmpeg/ffprobe paths and matching digests.
studio.diagnostic_code_COMPONENT_RESOURCES_UNVE: Generation fonts/resources were not found in the component wheel. Verify them before real composition.
studio.diagnosticNetwork: Model and material clients use declared environment proxies; Edge TTS receives an explicit proxy. Other TTS proxy combinations are unsupported. Configuration checks do not prove real connectivity.
studio.receiptBinding: Binding backed by a platform receipt
studio.decision_TOP_OBSERVED_VIEWS: Reference the eligible work with the highest observed views
studio.decision_INSUFFICIENT_DATA: Insufficient comparable data: use a manual topic
studio.decision_SUPERSEDED: Superseded by a newer selected observation
studio.decision_IMMATURE: Work has not reached the maturity threshold
studio.feedbackHint: Bind stable works, archive manual exports, and carry observation evidence into the next creation revision.
studio.manualEvidenceHint: Manual associations and metrics are user-supplied evidence. They never change send receipts, clear UNKNOWN locks, or establish live platform publication.
studio.confirmBinding: I confirm the exact account, platform work, media and publication time mapping.
studio.importHint: This version accepts the published LoopCast JSON schema and manually prepared exports. It does not automatically parse every platform CSV. Preserve each metric definition and aggregation scope.
studio.importRetryHint: After an uncertain upload, select the original unchanged file again to reuse its request identity. File digests also prevent duplicate observations.
studio.metricScopeHint: Missing values stay missing. Cumulative values form new snapshots; deltas require non-overlapping intervals. Counts are not silently summed.
studio.decisionHint: Select observations from one platform and evidence mode. The versioned rule records maturity, sample threshold and exclusions. You confirm or edit the next topic; generation and sending remain explicit actions. Synthetic examples do not prove traffic improvements.
studio.confirmDecision: I confirm this topic and brief as a new frozen creation revision.
studio.timezoneHint: Use an ISO timestamp with a timezone offset, for example 2026-01-01T12:00:00+08:00.
studio.feedback_code_WORK_UNBOUND: Create an explicit work binding, then reprocess
studio.feedback_code_MEDIA_MAPPING_MISMATCH: Media differs from the immutable work binding
studio.feedback_code_OBSERVATION_TIME_INVALID: Observation time is invalid, future, or before publication
studio.feedback_code_WINDOW_INVALID: Use valid timezone-aware delta intervals; cumulative values have no interval
studio.feedback_code_OBSERVATION_CONFLICT: The same observation has conflicting values
studio.feedback_code_DELTA_OVERLAP: Delta interval overlaps an existing observation
studio.feedback_code_COUNTER_DECREASE: Cumulative values conflict with earlier or later snapshots
studio.restoreGuardHint: External publications after the backup have not been fully reconciled. Uploads stay blocked across restart, login and configuration changes. History, media and diagnostics remain available.
studio.restoreGuardClear: No controlled-recovery barrier is recorded. Uploads still require valid configuration, accounts and permanent duplicate checks.
studio.operationsHint: Backups and recovery use the operator CLI while the service is stopped. This page provides read-only status and reports.
studio.backupNotObserved: Unavailable; verify the actual private package separately
studio.snapshotProvenanceHint: Declared versions, measured files and running-service observations are separate evidence. A distribution version does not establish its source revision or real provider readiness.
studio.reconciliationNotRestored: This workspace has no controlled-recovery boundary.
studio.reconciliationIncomplete: External coverage is incomplete. Unknown works after the backup remain outside the recorded history.
studio.reconciliationNoRelease: The current adapters cannot prove complete external coverage. There is no manual release switch; finding one work does not release the global barrier.
studio.knownWorkFound: Confirmed receipt found for this target
studio.reason_RESTORE_GUARD_ACTIVE: Recovery publication barrier is active. Reconcile the external history before uploads can be considered.
studio.evidence_RESTORE_BOUNDARY_UNKNOWN: The backup boundary cannot establish whether this attempt later sent. Its lock remains protected.
studio.observationValue_held: Held; health is a separate observation
studio.observationValue_COMPATIBLE_FORWARD_FIX_: Use a compatible forward version; retain all facts
studio.schedHint: Plan a finite sequence of already confirmed videos and frozen targets. Nothing generates new content or publishes until you explicitly enable the plan.
studio.schedNativeHint: Local due time allows an upload to start. It does not guarantee when a platform makes the video public or provide platform-native scheduling.
studio.schedDisabled: Automatic plans are blocked by service policy, sending permission or recovery status. You can prepare a paused plan.
studio.schedSelectHint: Choose existing frozen targets below. Each group uses one local date; daily dates follow this order. A target is used once, and missing or missed dates do not move its video to another day.
studio.schedClockPolicy: Repeated local times use the earlier UTC instant once. Missing daily times are skipped; a missing one-time time is rejected.
studio.schedBlocked: A target is waiting or blocked. Resolve its checks before enabling.
studio.schedGap: Skipped: this local time does not exist
studio.schedNoOccurrences: No slot has been processed. This does not mean anything was published.
studio.schedViewTarget: View original target, attempts and receipts
studio.schedBudget: UTC-day attempts: {{attempts}} · Pending target limit: {{pending}}. Account and service limits also apply.
studio.schedSkipHint: Missed groups are skipped after the normal 60-second window. New dates never grant permission to repeat a published or unresolved target.
studio.schedCatchupHint: Only bounded catch-up is allowed. The original slot identity and deadline remain in effect across restarts.
studio.schedInFlight: An upload was already handed to the adapter. Pause or cancel prevents new admissions; it cannot promise to undo an external effect. Its real result will be retained.
studio.schedEditHint: Dates, time zone and target identities stay fixed. Only future unprocessed slots can use a new rule. Saving keeps the plan paused until you review and enable it again.
studio.schedEffective: Apply from this future local date
studio.schedConfirmEnable: I confirm these videos, target accounts, local and UTC times, missed-slot policy and limits, and authorize this finite plan to run.
studio.schedOneOnly: A one-time plan needs one group. Use a finite daily plan for multiple groups.
studio.schedConfirmCreate: I reviewed the frozen videos, accounts, dates, time zone, missed-slot policy and limits. Save this plan paused.
studio.schedPreviewExpired: The preview expired. Review the current times and checks again before confirming.
studio.schedLimitError: The plan exceeds a trusted pending or attempt limit. Reduce the selection or requested limits.
studio.schedTimeError: Check the IANA zone, real calendar date, local time and future execution boundary.
studio.schedOwnedError: This target belongs to a plan. Control that plan before assigning the target elsewhere.
studio.schedFrozenError: An existing occurrence cannot change. Use a permitted future revision or explicitly cancel and prepare a new plan for a reliably unsent target.
studio.schedReason_AWAITING_CONFIRMATION: Paused; review and explicitly enable this plan.
studio.schedReason_USER_PAUSE: Paused by you. No new upload may start.
studio.schedReason_USER_CANCEL: Future authorizations cancelled; history is retained.
studio.schedReason_RESTORE_GUARD: Recovery requires publication reconciliation; plans stay paused.
studio.schedReason_CLOCK_BACKWARD: The service clock moved backwards. New admission waits until the saved time boundary is reached.
studio.schedReason_ACCOUNT_STALE: The account needs a fresh declared validity check.
studio.schedReason_ACCOUNT_UNAVAILABLE: The account is unavailable. Use account management to resolve it.
studio.schedReason_ACCOUNT_BUSY: Another attempt for this account remains active or unresolved.
studio.schedReason_CAPABILITY_UNAVAILABLE: The platform cannot currently perform this action.
studio.schedReason_SENDING_DISABLED: Sending is disabled by service policy.
studio.schedReason_LOCAL_SCHEDULING_DISABLED: Automatic local plans are disabled by trusted service policy.
studio.schedReason_ACCOUNT_QUOTA_EXHAUSTED: The account UTC-day attempt budget is exhausted.
studio.schedReason_PLAN_QUOTA_EXHAUSTED: The plan UTC-day attempt budget is exhausted.
studio.schedReason_ACCOUNT_QUOTA_PENDING: The account pending target bound is reached.
studio.schedReason_GLOBAL_QUOTA_PENDING: The service pending target bound is reached.
studio.schedReason_QUOTA_HISTORY_UNAVAILABLE: Earlier attempt time evidence is incomplete; the service cannot safely grant more budget.
studio.schedReason_PERMANENT_DUPLICATE: This media lineage was already published to the stable account.
studio.schedReason_PUBLICATION_UNRESOLVED: An earlier publication is unresolved; no automatic resend.
studio.schedReason_PUBLICATION_NOT_RETRYABLE: This frozen target is not eligible for another send.
studio.schedReason_FROZEN_INPUT_CHANGED: The confirmed media or target identity changed.
studio.schedReason_ASSET_CHANGED: The frozen video identity no longer matches the registered video.
studio.schedReason_EVIDENCE_MISMATCH: The frozen account and current evidence mode do not match.
studio.schedReason_AI_DISCLOSURE_UNAVAILABLE: The requested AI disclosure cannot be applied by this adapter.
studio.schedReason_CATEGORY_REQUIRED: A required platform category is missing.
studio.schedReason_VISIBILITY_UNAVAILABLE: The frozen visibility is not supported.
studio.schedReason_TITLE_TOO_LONG: The frozen title exceeds the platform limit.
studio.schedReason_QUEUE_FULL: The bounded publication queue is full.
studio.schedReason_TARGET_ATTEMPT_LIMIT: The original target reached its controlled attempt bound.
studio.schedReason_EXECUTOR_UNRESOLVED: An earlier execution identity or result is unresolved.
studio.schedReason_SLOT_EXPIRED: The original slot deadline passed; no new upload was started.
studio.schedReason_SKIPPED_MISSED: The slot was missed and skipped.
studio.schedReason_SKIPPED_TIME_GAP: The local time does not exist; this group was skipped.
studio.schedReason_PROVEN_NOT_SENT: Reliably not sent. A retry requires explicit confirmation of the original occurrence.
studio.schedReason_USER_RECONFIRMED: You explicitly reconfirmed the original occurrence.
studio.schedReason_QUEUED: Queued for the original publication attempt.
studio.schedReason_READY: Waiting for the confirmed local time and final checks.
studio.schedReason_PUBLISHED: A trusted publication receipt confirms this target.
studio.schedReason_UNKNOWN: The external result is unknown; no automatic resend.
studio.schedReason_SUBMITTED: Submitted is not confirmed publication; no automatic resend.
studio.schedReason_CANCELLED: Cancelled before a new send; prior facts are retained.
studio.schedNoTargets: No eligible frozen targets. Prepare and freeze content with its accounts in the publishing form above.
studio.inspectHint: Read-only observations reuse the existing diagnostics. Checking never generates content, calls a paid model, signs in or uploads.
studio.inspectLiveBoundary: A ready service, configured component and callable installation are different facts. Identity checks do not verify real publication.
studio.inspectNotChecked: No check has been recorded. A declared capability is not a successful observation.
studio.inspectNoEvents: No retained state changes. Stable repeated results do not create new notifications.
studio.inspectRetention: History is bounded. Older linked reports and events may retire together.
studio.inspectOnlineConsent: I confirm a read-only identity check for this account. No login or publication will start.
studio.inspectPending: A check request has an unknown response. Refreshing only reads; retry keeps the original request identity.
studio.inspectVersionChanged: The channel changed while you reviewed it. Your online selection is retained; review the current version before checking.
studio.inspectCooldown: Retry is available in about {{seconds}} seconds.
studio.inspectForbiddenCounts: Observed calls: generation {{generate}}, paid model {{model}}, login {{login}}, upload {{upload}}.
studio.inspectReasonFallback: Check the recorded observation and its applicable version.
studio.inspectReason_OK: The recorded check passed within its scope.
studio.inspectReason_COMPONENT_UNAVAILABLE: The pinned component installation is unavailable.
studio.inspectReason_MEDIA_UNAVAILABLE: Media version or digest validation failed.
studio.inspectReason_SERVICE_NOT_READY: The application owner is not ready.
studio.inspectReason_CHECK_TIMEOUT: The check timed out; this is an unknown observation, not proof of invalid credentials.
studio.inspectReason_CHECK_UNAVAILABLE: The check could not complete. Private tool output is not shown.
studio.inspectReason_IDENTITY_INVALID: The read-only identity result did not match this account.
studio.inspectReason_IDENTITY_UNVERIFIED: Account identity could not be verified; no login was started.
studio.inspectReason_INPUT_CHANGED: The input version changed before the result could apply.
studio.inspectReason_ACCOUNT_DISCONNECTED: This account has no connected credentials.
studio.inspectReason_ONLINE_CHECK_NOT_REQUESTED: Only existing account observations were read. No online check was requested.
studio.inspectReason_STORED_OBSERVATION_ONLY: This is a stored observation, not a new platform check.
studio.inspectReason_CHECK_CLOCK_CHANGED: The clock moved backward during the check; its timing is uncertain.
studio.inspectReason_COMPONENT_WHEEL_INVALID: The component wheel or its digest is invalid.
studio.inspectReason_PROVIDER_CONFIG_INVALID: The private provider configuration is invalid.
studio.inspectReason_COMPONENT_CLI_UNSUPPORTED: The required CLI contract was not verified.
